proof_text:
An element $x$ belongs to $A \cup \emptyset$ if and only if
$x \in A \lor x \in \emptyset$. Since $\emptyset$ has no members, the
predicate $x \in \emptyset$ is identically false for all $x$. Thus
$x \in A \lor \text{false} \iff x \in A$. By Extensionality,
$A \cup \emptyset = A$.

Theorem:
given: A is \set
then: (.A \.set.union./ \empty.set.) = A
Documented:
. called: "Empty Set Union Identity"
. description: "Union of any set $A$ with the empty set yields $A$:
                $A \cup \emptyset = A$."
